LanguageData.LP_LegUnyielding.label: unyielding warrior
LanguageData.LP_LegUnyielding.description: Legendary passive: once per day, when you would fall you stay up instead, instantly heal half your injuries and fully restore grit. Legendary fighter.
LanguageData.LP_LegThousandArmies.label: army breaker
LanguageData.LP_LegThousandArmies.description: Legendary: sweep a 90° cone toward the target. With a melee weapon, every enemy within 5 cells takes a melee resolution at ×3 damage (guaranteed hit); with a ranged weapon, every enemy within weapon range takes one guaranteed-hit bullet at ×3 damage. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary fighter.
LanguageData.LP_LegFormless.label: formless body
LanguageData.LP_LegFormless.description: Legendary passive: melee dodge +25%, immune to stuns. Legendary monk.
LanguageData.LP_LegHeavenPalm.label: heaven-shaking palm
LanguageData.LP_LegHeavenPalm.description: Legendary: press a palm against an adjacent enemy: first a melee resolution, then a shock to the torso for 80 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) blunt damage (ignoring 80% of armor), stunning for 10 seconds. Legendary monsters and story bosses have a 50% chance to break the stun. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary monk.
LanguageData.LP_LegDivineIncarnation.label: divine avatar
LanguageData.LP_LegDivineIncarnation.description: Legendary: become divine light for 30 seconds: enemies within radius 8 take 10 × divine power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage per second (doubled against undead and fiends), allies heal half that per second and don't panic or have mental breaks. Cooldown 2 days. Legendary paladin.
LanguageData.LP_LegUndyingOath.label: unbroken oath
LanguageData.LP_LegUndyingOath.description: Legendary passive: you and allies within 8 cells get +10% success on all saves. Multiple paladins don't stack. Legendary paladin.
LanguageData.LP_LegSpellMastery.label: empowered spells
LanguageData.LP_LegSpellMastery.description: Legendary passive: damage and healing of spells using arcane power (all wizard spells, the sorcerer's Intellectual branch) ×1.3; wizard spell mana cost -1 (minimum 1). Legendary wizard.
LanguageData.LP_LegMeteorSwarm.label: meteor swarm
LanguageData.LP_LegMeteorSwarm.description: Legendary: 4 meteors fall one after another in radius 4 at a point within 30 cells, each a fire explosion of radius 2.5 dealing 35 × arcane power (× psychic sensitivity) damage. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary wizard.
LanguageData.LP_LegDivineIntervention.label: divine intervention
LanguageData.LP_LegDivineIntervention.description: Legendary: pray to the gods for a miracle: all colonists on this map are fully healed and cured of disease, and colonist corpses dead no more than 3 days are revived (except liches, necromantic constructs and those without a brain). Cooldown 30 days. Legendary cleric.
LanguageData.LP_LegDivineGuardian.label: divine guardian
LanguageData.LP_LegDivineGuardian.description: Legendary passive: divine power +20%; Revivify costs only 2 divinity. Legendary cleric.
LanguageData.LP_LegTimelessDruid.label: timeless druid
LanguageData.LP_LegTimelessDruid.description: Legendary passive: no longer ages after adulthood; Wild Shape costs no mana. Legendary druid.
LanguageData.LP_LegNatureWrath.label: nature's wrath
LanguageData.LP_LegNatureWrath.description: Legendary: raise a storm in radius 6 at a point within 30 cells: 4 lightning bolts each strike an enemy (or the area when there are none), each 30 × verdant power (× psychic sensitivity) electrical damage; enemies in range are entangled by vines for 10 seconds × verdant power. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary druid.
LanguageData.LP_LegBloodlineAwakening.label: bloodline awakening
LanguageData.LP_LegBloodlineAwakening.description: Legendary passive: innate power +20%; with a sorcerer bloodline, damage of the bloodline's element taken ×0.5 (fire genasi, genies, cambions: fire; water genasi: frostbite; earth genasi, titans: blunt; air genasi, storm giants, cloud giants: lightning; mariliths: sharp). Legendary sorcerer.
LanguageData.LP_LegArcaneSurge.label: arcane torrent
LanguageData.LP_LegArcaneSurge.description: Legendary: the next 3 class spells (abilities that cost resources) within 1 day cost no resources and trigger no cooldown. Cooldown 2 days. Legendary sorcerer.
LanguageData.LP_LegSoulforge.label: soulforged
LanguageData.LP_LegSoulforge.description: Legendary passive: crafted DND weapons (those in the artificer requirement table) get +1 quality, with another 10% chance to become legendary outright. Legendary artificer.
